scripts.name: Copy local environment from main
scripts.command: main_worktree="$(git worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree / { path = substr($0, 10) } $0 == "branch refs/heads/main" { print path; exit }')"; if [ -n "$main_worktree" ] && [ -f "$main_worktree/.env" ] && [ ! -e .env ]; then (umask 077; cp "$main_worktree/.env" .env); fi
